question: Ustad Bismillah Khan is associated with which of the following instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shehnai.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Bismillah Khan** is a renowned Indian musician who is primarily associated with playing the **shehnai,** a wind instrument.
 
• He is considered to be one of the** greatest shehnai players **of all time.
 
• India's highest civilian award, the **Bharat Ratna**, was given to Bismillah Khan in **2001.**

 In **2006**, the nation marked a national day of **mourning **in his honor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **veena **is a **stringed instrument** that is commonly used in **Carnatic music** from South India.

 
 
• A famous veena player from India is **Asad Ali Khan.**
 
 
 
• The **flute** is another** wind instrument** that is popular in Indian classical music.
 
 
• **Pt. Ronu Majumdar** is regarded as the most illustrious figure in contemporary Indian flute playing.
 
 
 
• The **violin** is a **Western classical **instrument that is not typically used in Indian classical music.
 
 
• Hindustani violinists like **N. Rajam and Sangeeta Shankar** are extremely skilled worldwide performers.
